silhouette: Masked lean muscular alien humanoid with broad shoulders, a narrower waist, long organic arms/legs and long dark head tendrils; source film establishes head/upper silhouette, licensed photographs supply the resolved fullbody support. No numerical height or age is inferred.
anatomy: Two organic arms and two organic legs, clawed alien hands and two bare clawed alien feet, with dark wraps around the ankles. Organic elbows/knees/hips must remain continuous rather than literal exposed figure pivots or cut plastic seams. Do not invent an exact toe count, unseen plantar surface or human footwear.
costume: Bone biomask remains ON. Source-visible layered waist covering and the licensed gray segmented front waist plate with dark fringe/side coverings remain in the selected intact appearance. Lower-body details are licensed costume support, not neutral-lit production-frame certification. No human clothing default, diamond body-net suit or unrelated Predator armor.
palette: Pale bone/ivory-gray biomask, dark black tendrils and dark gray equipment. Warm tan/brown mottled skin, dark markings and warm central body tones are supported by the licensed photographs; foggy/cool primary film images do not certify a neutral skin color, exact RGB values or a brightened toy-gloss material.
face: Keep the elongated cracked pale bone biomask and its tapered lower shape as actually visible in the Prey film references. The masked mouth/mandible contours are limited to what is visible below it. Never replace this with a human face, the1987 silver Jungle Hunter mask, or the loose unmasked NECA alternate head; hidden face, exact iris tint and unseen facial geometry remain unknown.
distinguishingMarks: Source-specific long dark tendrils, elongated cracked bone mask and mottled exposed limbs distinguish this Feral incarnation. Licensed marking placement is an appearance support, not a certified spot/crack count or a microscopic engraving map. Preserve anatomical RIGHT/LEFT equipment asymmetry; do not mirror it or add unrelated shoulder weapons.
equipment: Anatomical RIGHT wrist: exactly two curved metal wrist blades are visibly supplied by the licensed posed photograph; extend them only when that composition calls for them. Anatomical LEFT forearm: source-compatible segmented shield, with the deployed circular front shown in the film shield frame and licensed posed view. Film/figure evidence is scoped separately; no invented reverse hardware or segment count.

Only source-visible forearm housings, dorsal apparatus and attached costume portions may be used within the corresponding view limits. Loose accessory-display parts are not a mandatory permanent arsenal. Do not add a Classic1987 shoulder plasma caster or another Predator weapon by familiarity.
forbiddenMixes: No unmasked alternate head, human face/boots,1987 silver mask/body net, later Predator costume, Bear Blood or Camo Reveal coloration, ULTRAmate accessory assortment, glossy toy flesh, exposed mechanical toy joints, loose display limbs, invented toe counts or hidden surfaces.

scopeLimitations: The three official production images are medium/close/rear crops. None resolves the entire actual film body and feet. Film wholebody qualification is explicitly false; licensed fullbody support is not relabeled as production photography.

Only the fog film reference is the primary selected masked identity image. Shield and back frames support their actually visible equipment/costume regions; their falseidentity flags must not be silently promoted.

NECA photographs are official licensed product images, not film stills. They support the body/costume/feet/visible equipment only, with usedForIdentity=false; toy joint seams, plastic gloss, staged background, alternate unmasked head and loose display parts are excluded.

Selected incarnation remains intact and masked Prey2022. Unmasked face/iris geometry, exact toe count, tiny markings, hidden underside/reverse surfaces and a neutral film skin palette remain unresolved.

RIGHT twin curved wrist blades and LEFT shield are directly legible in the licensed posed photograph. No claim is made that an occluded hand attachment or every segment/routing is proven by the shield closeup alone.
